name: MListView
description: A scrolling list of tiles; e.Index tells which row was tapped.

properties.name: Items
properties.description: Rows separated by ; with fields separated by | (matching ItemTemplate).

properties.name: ItemTemplate
properties.description: Fields of a row: title, subtitle, icon, trailing - separated by | (e.g. icon|title|subtitle).

events.name: Tap
events.description: The user tapped the control (MListView / Drawer: e.Index = the item).
